key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for standard passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of perovskite solar cells require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures across 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Evaluate an open 14B model with structured SQL access on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature, with text retrieval especially weak on extrema, distributions, and filtered counts.
watch_item: Structured retrieval depends on accurate table extraction and still leaves nearly half of benchmark questions unanswered correctly.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
